name: @visuallyjs/browser-ui-react-mcp

tools.name: visuallyjs_react_doc
tools.description: Get a documentation page, demonstration overview or source file for visuallyjs_react. Read demonstrations/index to list bundled demos.

path.description: The relative path to this page from the documentation root.

tools.name: visuallyjs_react
tools.description: Search VisuallyJs React documentation and apidocs. Includes bundled demonstration overviews and source code.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: visuallyjs_react_export_demo
tools.description: Restore a bundled demonstration, including images, into a new or empty absolute directory on the MCP server. Does not install dependencies or run scripts. Find ids and files in demonstrations/index via the doc tool.

destination.description: Absolute destination directory on the MCP server; must be new or empty and not a symlink.

tools.name: search_vjs_react
tools.description: Search VisuallyJs React docs (deprecated, use visuallyjs_react)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: search_vjs_react_api
tools.description: Search VisuallyJs React apidocs (deprecated, use visuallyjs_react)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

lib.description: Optional name of the library to narrow searches to - should be one of `react`, `angular`, `vue`, `svelte` or `vanilla`.
